confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Kathmandu tourist price levels, not live listings. Restaurant, coffee and dorm anchors are moderately reliable; the 3-star hotel and wine anchors are least certain. July is monsoon low season, so hotel rates may run below peak. USD values depend on an unsourced NPR/USD assumption. The fx observation was taken from search-result text attributed to the RBA exchange rates table and could not be confirmed on a second RBA page; verify against the live table.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was matched; estimates reflect general knowledge of Thamel and wider Kathmandu tourist price levels. Cocktail and wine anchors were set relative to the local beer anchor because direct bar-price knowledge is weak.

anchor_basis.beer: Everest or Gorkha lager, one standard serving at a Thamel restaurant, about 400 NPR
anchor_basis.coffee: cappuccino at a typical Thamel cafe, about 350 NPR
anchor_basis.inexp_meal_1p: momo or dal bhat set with a soft drink at a budget local eatery, about 400 NPR
anchor_basis.midrange_meal_2p: three courses for two (starter, main, dessert, no drinks) at a mid-range Thamel restaurant, about 4,000 NPR total
anchor_basis.cocktail: gin and tonic or mojito at a Thamel bar, about 700 NPR
anchor_basis.wine_glass: imported house red or white by the glass at a Thamel restaurant, about 800 NPR
anchor_basis.hostel_dorm_1p: bed in a multi-bed dorm at a registered Thamel hostel, about 700 NPR per night
anchor_basis.hostel_private_2p: private double room at a Thamel hostel, about 1,600 NPR per night
anchor_basis.hotel_1star_2p: basic double room with attached bath at a registered Thamel guesthouse, about 1,800 NPR per night
anchor_basis.hotel_3star_2p: double room at a registered three-star Kathmandu hotel, about 7,000 NPR per night in low season
